key_impacts: Large quantities of radioactive material were released.
Over three hundred thousand residents were evacuated from the vicinity.
Cleanup expected to take decades and cost hundreds of billions of dollars.
evidence_snippets: The accident at Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station on March 11, 2011.
About forty-five minutes after the earthquake, the station was inundated by tsunami waves.
Large quantities of radioactivity were released; over three hundred thousand residents evacuated.
missing_information: Names of evacuated settlements not specified
